full_judgment: 4. Heard the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the opposite party and perused the application for condonation of delay under section 5 of the Limitation Act along with the materials on record: It appears that the explanation given for the delay of 309 days in the application for condonation of delay is merely in the nature of a general explanation and not on day-to-day basis and, as such; it is not a sufficient explanation within the meaning as contemplated in section 5 of the Limitation Act. It appears from the application that the reason for the delay was narrated and explained in a very slipshod general manner giving rise to form the opinion that the delay was due to the laches and gross negligence on the part of the petitioner. I do not find any substance in the Rule.
